boundary_reason: Stable policy selection of 80 revisions, no source-identity truncation. Source verification is not semantic completion.

entries.source: The target has appeared out of nowhere! It's defense is boosted by %d.
entries.target: 目标不知从哪里冒出来！闪避值增加 %d。

entries.source: @Source@ places several targets out of phase.
entries.target: @Source@让数名目标从相位空间移出。

entries.source: a pair of leather boots of phasing

A towering creature, made from the bones of hundreds of dead bodies. It is covered by an unholy aura.
This specimen looks like it was hastily assembled and is not really complete yet.
entries.target:
一座铁塔一样的怪物，由数百具尸体的骨头组成。它周身环绕着不洁的光环。
这个标本看起来像是仓促拼凑而成，尚未真正完成。

entries.source: You have destroyed the merchant caravan that you once considered family.
entries.target: 你摧毁了那个你曾经视作家人的商队。

entries.source:
When moving over 800%% speed for at least 3 steps in the same direction, you become so fast you can blink through obstacles as if they were not there.
		While moving this fast you have 50%% chances to fully ignore an attack by displacing yourself (this may only happen once per turn).
		Changing direction will break the effect.
entries.target:
沿同一方向以超过 800%% 的速度连续移动至少 3 步后，你可以无视障碍物移动。
		移动过程中，你有 50%% 几率通过换位无视攻击，每回合最多触发一次。
		变换方向会打断此效果。
你脚下什么东西发出了不祥的咔嗒声。

entries.source: Call on which aspect of the staff?
Harness the power of ice to freeze and shatter your foes.
entries.target: 使用冰的力量冰冻并粉碎你的目标。

entries.source: Take on the defining aspects of a Sand Drake.
entries.target: 化身成为土龙形态使你能使用土龙技能。

entries.source: Do not try to resist it!
Summon an undead minion of pure darkness to harass your foes.
entries.target: 召唤至暗的不死随从，骚扰你的敌人。

entries.source: #Target# is free from the worm rot.
Defilers are touched by the mark of evil. They are a blight on the world. Working to promote the cause of evil, they serve their masters, or themselves become masters.
entries.target: 堕落系职业身上带有邪恶的印记，他们是世界的祸害。他们为邪恶事业效力，侍奉他们的主人，或者自己成为主人。

entries.source: Oh, easy. You get a swig of each brew, of course. They'll put hair on your chest, and possibly your eyelids and fingernails. And, if your aid proves the deciding factor, then I've got a real treat for you: perhaps the last Taint of Purging left in Maj'Eyal.
entries.target: 很简单，每份药剂我都会让你先喝个痛快的。喝下这些药剂会让你长出有男子汉气概的胸毛，可能还能长你脸上或者指甲盖里。而且，要是你的帮助能起决定性作用的话，我还会额外给你一件真正的宝物：传说中马基·埃亚尔唯一的堕落印记——清除印记哦。

entries.source: Reach out and touch the blood and health of your foes. Any creatures caught in the radius 2 ball will be unable to heal above their current life value (at the time of the casting) for %d turns.
entries.target: 掌控敌人的血液和肉体。在 2 码范围内，任何被鲜血禁锢攻击到的敌人的治疗或回复将不能超过当前生命值，持续 %d 回合。

entries.source: A living stone vine holds the target in place, inflicting %0.1f Nature%s damage per turn.
entries.target: 一条活着的石藤将目标钉在原地，每回合造成 %0.1f 点自然%s伤害。

entries.source: Replace headwear images by cloak hoods if a cloak is worn#WHITE#
entries.target: 当戴着斗篷时，用斗篷兜帽替换头部装备图像。#WHITE#

entries.source:
Jump back up to %d grids from your target, springing over any creatures in your way. 
		You must disengage in a nearly straight line directly away from your target (which you must be able to see).
		After moving, you gain %d%% increased movement speed for 3 turns (which ends if you take any actions other than movement), and you may reload your ammo (if any).
		The extra speed and maximum distance you can move are reduced by your Fatigue level.
entries.target:
指定目标，向后跳跃 %d 格，可以跃过途中所有生物。
		你必须选择可见目标，必须以近乎直线的轨迹后跳。
		落地后，你获得 3 回合 %d%% 移动速度加成，采取除移动外的行动会提前终止，并可以重新装填弹药（若有）。
		移动速度和跳跃距离会受疲劳值影响。

entries.source: Wanderers are adventurers who embrace the chaotic nature of the world. They start the game with the Combat Training talent tree, 3 random class trees and 1 random generic tree.
entries.target: 流浪者是拥抱世界混乱本质的冒险家。进入游戏时，他们初始拥有战斗训练系，3个随机职业技能系以及1个随机通用技能系。

entries.source: call forth an immobile antimagic pillar for 10 turns.  (It spits slime, pulls in, stuns, and burns the arcane resources of your foes, while emitting an aura of silence against them within range 5, and will silence you for 5 turns when first summoned.)
entries.target: 召唤一个无法移动的反魔石柱 10 回合。（它可以喷吐史莱姆、拉拽、震慑并燃烧敌人的奥术资源，同时在5码范围内对它们施放沉默光环，并且首次召唤时会沉默你5回合。）

entries.source: You should head back to Irkkk.
#YELLOW#I TIRE OF YOUR NAGGING QUESTIONS. TALK, TALK, TALK. YOU HAVE A SIMPLE CHOICE BEFORE YOU. WILL YOU BECOME POWERFUL? OR WILL YOU BE WEAK AND ALONE?
entries.target: #YELLOW#我已经厌倦了你这喋喋不休的追问。说，说，说个没完。摆在你面前的选择很简单：你是要变得强大？还是要弱小又孤独？

entries.source: Creates a wormhole nearby and a second wormhole up to ten tiles away.
entries.target: 在附近生成一个虫洞，并在最远十格处生成第二个虫洞。

entries.source: I've lost a number of adventurers to this one, but I'm sure you'll be fine.
entries.target: 我已经在这个工作中失去了许多冒险者，但我确信你会安全归来。

entries.source:
Your desolate wastes are now rapidly crumbling.
		Any foe moving through them is likely to get cut, taking %0.2f cold damage and bleeding over 4 turns (stacking) while reducing its movement speed by 15%%.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
你的荒芜大地开始破碎。
		在荒芜大地上移动的敌人有几率被冰划伤流血受伤，受到 %0.2f 寒冷伤害，流血 4 回合（可以叠加），并降低移动速度 15%%。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

entries.source:
You do not understand the inscriptions there.#WHITE#*
#{italic}#"Rokzan krilt copru."#{normal}#
entries.target:
你看不懂那里的铭文。#WHITE#*
#{italic}#"Rokzan krilt copru."#{normal}#

entries.source: You have learnt all the inscription slots you could.
entries.target: 你已经解锁了所有的刻印位。

entries.source: In the aftermath of the Spellblaze, the Thaloren had to defend their forests against foes and fires alike. Many of the trees died despite the efforts of the Elves to save them. Their wood was fashioned into a bow to be wielded against the darkness.
entries.target: 在魔法大爆炸的余波里，自然精灵不得不从敌人和大火中保卫他们的森林。尽管精灵们奋力的抢救它们，许多树还是死掉了。它们的遗体被打造成一张弓用来抵御黑暗的侵袭。
操控闪电能量的炼金法术。
在 Lua 中查看 [陷阱]

entries.source:
You peer into three possible futures, allowing you to explore each for %d turns.  When the effect expires, you'll choose which of the three futures becomes your present.
		If you know Foresight you'll gain additional defense and chance to shrug off critical hits (equal to your Foresight values) while See the Threads is active.
		This spell splits the timeline.  Attempting to use another spell that also splits the timeline while this effect is active will be unsuccessful.
		If you die in any thread you'll revert the timeline to the point when you first cast the spell and the effect will end.
		This spell may only be used once per zone level.
entries.target:
你窥视三种可能的未来，允许你分别进行探索 %d 回合。当效果结束，你选择三者之一成为你的现在。
		如果你学会了深谋远虑，当你使用命运螺旋时，将获得额外的闪避和暴击减免（数值等于深谋远虑的奖励）。
		这个法术会使时间线分裂。当此技能激活的时候，使用其他分裂时间线的技能将会失败。
		如果你在任何一条时间线上死亡，你将使时间线回到你使用技能的地方，并且技能效果结束。
		这个技能每个楼层只能使用一次。

entries.source:
Welcome #LIGHT_GREEN#@name@#WHITE#.
You have arrived in the Infinite Dungeon.
Your life outside did not satisfy you, so you came here looking for adventure.
While you know this is a one way trip, you hope to go in a blaze of glory!

Go forth, venture into the depths of the dungeon and see how far you can get before the end.
entries.target:
欢迎你 #LIGHT_GREEN#@name@#WHITE#！
你来到了无尽地下城。
外面的生活无法满足你，所以你到了这里寻求冒险。
你很清楚，这是一条有去无回的道路，却希望能轰轰烈烈地结束这一生！

向前去，进入地下城深处去冒险吧，看看在生命终点到来前你能走多远。

entries.source: #VIOLET#You enter the swirling portal and in the blink of an eye you set foot in strange empty space...
entries.target: #VIOLET#你进入了传送漩涡，一眨眼功夫你发现你到了一个陌生的空地…

entries.source: I require all the help I can get, not for my sake but for the town of Derth, to the northwest of here.
entries.target: 我需要一切能得到的帮助，不是为了我自己，而是为了西北方的德斯小镇。

entries.source: Hello friend, what can I do for you?
entries.target: 你好，朋友，有什么我能为你效劳的吗？

entries.source: Tap on the core arcane forces of the aether, unleashing devastating effects on your foes.
entries.target: 释放以太的核心力量，将敌人毁灭。
